activity.deniedBody: This part of the application belongs to a business activity that is not enabled for your company, so it cannot be opened from a direct link either. Ask your administrator if the activity needs to be switched.
activity.configuringBody: This is your company's active business activity, but its dedicated pages are not installed yet. Shared apps (CRM, HR, accounting, tasks) remain fully available.
activity.settingsSubtitle: The selected activity determines which domain pages, navigation items and shortcuts the whole company sees. Display names never change the underlying logic.
activity.switchNote: Switching only changes the visible experience: existing records of other activities (projects, leases, patients, students, invoices) stay intact and are restored when their activity becomes active again. Open pages refresh to the new state after saving.
activity.saveError: Could not save the business activity. Check your connection and permissions.
